## How to Comment

Anyone may comment, whether or not they are an OSTERA Member. Comments are accepted from the opening date through the closing date. Either:

* open an issue in the [JSON Signature Scheme (JSS) repository](https://github.com/OSTERA-org-Working-Groups/jss/issues/new/choose), or
* send an email to [public-review@ostera.org](mailto:public-review@ostera.org?subject=draft-ts-jcs-01%20for%20version%201.0).

Please include the draft name and version (draft-ts-jcs-01 for version 1.0) and the section your comment is about. Anything you submit is a contribution under the [OSTERA IPR and Copyright Policy](https://ostera.org/policies/). By submitting it, you agree to the terms of that policy (Article 3). Do not submit anything confidential (Article 4).

## Outcome

After the review closes, the working group addresses every comment before it can approve the work item (Working Methods, Article 30). The response to the comments will be linked here.
